entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/main` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #86419
  • Update tokenization/colorization for file-based apps directives metadata #86415
  • Renamer.RenameSymbolAsync shadows a captured primary-constructor parameter without reporting a conflict #86408
  • Razor formatting moves only part of a multiline ternary that is a whole attribute value #86402
  • Razor formatting throws "The changes must not overlap" for a three-line C# attribute value with a Razor transition on the middle line #86401
  • Razor formatting mis-indents a multiline C# attribute value that contains a Razor transition #86400
  • Razor formatting re-indents a multiline expression that starts a line inside a quoted attribute value #86399
  • Razor formatting mis-indents an element whose start tag isn't first on its line, and everything after it #86398
  • Razor formatting over-indents everything after a script block whose end tag shares a line, when ignoring complex script indentation is off #86397
  • Razor formatting closes an element twice when its end tag is split across lines inside a code block #86396
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis* 5.12 nuget packages missing - .net 11 Release #86395
  • Razor component binding can resolve a different type when names collide #86394
    Backlog
  • Simplifier retains qualified names after removing a cast from a target-typed conditional (4.8 vs 5.9) #86393
  • CS8940 (ERR_WrongArityAsyncReturn) is only reported during emit but is not classified as a build-only diagnostic #86391
    Backlog

Closed

  • IDE0028 (Collection initialization can be simplified) false positive on target typed Dictionary creation #86411
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12410.350 #86403
  • ControlFlowGraph omits the lowering of a lock on System.Threading.Lock when nullable annotations are enabled #86321
